title: Do Audio and Lyrics Agree? Emotion-Aware Music Retrieval with Cross-Modal Coherence (code)
description:
Code for the paper Do Audio and Lyrics Agree? Emotion-Aware Music Retrieval with Cross-Modal Coherence (PeerJ Computer Science, under review).

Given a query track, the code ranks a catalog of 2,075 tracks from the MERGE dataset using content alone: audio embeddings (MuQ, MERT, CLAP, handcrafted), lyric embeddings (SBERT and others), or a fusion of the two. Retrieval is scored against the tracks' arousal–valence annotations. Per-track audio–lyrics coherence is measured with cross-fitted ridge probes and bootstrap intervals.

The repository contains the analysis notebooks, a memory-bounded audio-encoder extraction script, a headless notebook runner and a script that downloads the released outputs (embeddings, per-query results, tables, figures) from Zenodo. The MERGE dataset (CC BY-NC 4.0) is not included; download it from Zenodo (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.13939205).
